translations.chinese: "除普通英文字母、数字、标点和空格外的字符会显示为 \\u{…} 代码，因为有些字符可能不可见或看起来像其他字符；每个反斜杠会显示两次。"

translations.original: "The command wasn't run. Claude Code couldn't tell which version of this plugin's marketplace the command comes from, so it can't check that the command you accept is the one that would run."
translations.chinese: "命令未运行。Claude Code 无法判断此命令来自此插件应用市场的哪个版本，因此无法确认你接受的命令就是实际会运行的命令。"

translations.original: "Yours was added from the same address with a sign-in or other settings the link doesn't include, so the link's marketplace wasn't added. Install the plugin from the Plugins tab instead."
translations.chinese: "你的应用市场是从同一地址添加的，但带有链接未包含的登录或其他设置，因此未添加链接的应用市场。请改为从“插件”标签页安装该插件。"

translations.original: "When on, Claude in Chrome connects in the sessions open in this window and in every new session, here and outside this editor. When off, it connects here only when you use @browser."
translations.chinese: "开启时，Claude in Chrome 会在此窗口中打开的会话以及每个新会话中连接，包括此编辑器内外。关闭时，仅在你使用 @browser 时在此连接。"

translations.original: "Site-level permissions are inherited from the Chrome extension. Manage permissions in the Chrome extension settings to control which sites Claude can browse, click, and type on."
translations.chinese: "站点级权限继承自 Chrome 扩展。请在 Chrome 扩展设置中管理权限，以控制 Claude 可以浏览、点击和在哪些网站上输入。"

translations.original: "Saved to your user settings, but this session still shows the previous value. A project or managed setting may be overriding it, or the session hasn't picked the change up yet."
translations.chinese: "已保存到你的用户设置，但本次会话仍显示之前的值。项目或托管设置可能覆盖了它，或者会话尚未应用该更改。"

translations.original: "That entry gives it a different source, so the link's marketplace wasn't added and the plugin wasn't installed. If you can edit that entry, change it, then open the link again."
translations.chinese: "该条目为其指定了不同的来源，因此未添加链接的应用市场，也未安装插件。如果你可以编辑该条目，请更改它，然后再次打开链接。"

translations.original: "A large result is paid for again on every later request until it's compacted or cleared. Ask for narrower reads, searches and command output, or hand noisy work to a subagent."
translations.chinese: "大型结果在后续每个请求中都会再次计费，直到被压缩或清除。请要求更精确的读取、搜索和命令输出，或将噪声较多的工作交给子代理。"

translations.original: "Bare mode: hooks from settings files, plugins, and managed policies are disabled and will not run this session; session hooks created by /goal, agents, and skills still run. "
translations.chinese: "裸模式：来自设置文件、插件和托管策略的钩子已禁用，本次会话不会运行；由 /goal、Agent 和技能创建的会话钩子仍会运行。"

translations.original: "The command wasn't run. Claude Code treated this request as coming from another Claude Code session, so it didn't count your acceptance. Copy the error to see what happened."
translations.chinese: "命令未运行。Claude Code 认为此请求来自另一个 Claude Code 会话，因此未计入你的接受操作。请复制错误以查看发生了什么。"

translations.original: "A workflow fans a task out to many agents, and each one runs its own requests. Save them for big tasks. Ultracode starts one on every task; the model picker turns it off."
translations.chinese: "工作流会把任务分发给多个 Agent，每个 Agent 都会运行自己的请求。请将它们用于大型任务。Ultracode 会在每个任务上启动一个工作流；可在模型选择器中关闭。"

translations.original: "The link's marketplace was added. On the Plugins tab, install this plugin only from the marketplace with the source below; the Marketplaces tab shows each one's source."
translations.chinese: "链接的应用市场已添加。在“插件”标签页中，只能从下方来源的应用市场安装此插件；“应用市场”标签页会显示每个应用市场的来源。"

translations.original: "Your organization restricts hooks to managed and plugin sources. Hooks from user, project, local, and flag settings will not run, and managed hooks are not shown here."
translations.chinese: "你的组织将钩子限制为托管和插件来源。来自用户、项目、本地和启动设置的钩子不会运行，且此处不显示托管钩子。"

translations.original: "Complete the sign-in in the browser window that opened; it ends on a page that shows a code to paste below. You have five minutes; closing this dialog cancels it."
translations.chinese: "请在打开的浏览器窗口中完成登录；结束时页面会显示一个验证码，请粘贴到下方。你有五分钟时间；关闭此对话框将取消操作。"

translations.original: "Uncached input is expensive, and often happens when sending a message to a session that has gone idle. /compact before stepping away keeps the cold-start small."
translations.chinese: "未缓存的输入开销很大，通常发生在向已空闲的会话发送消息时。离开前运行 /compact 可减小冷启动开销。"

translations.original: "CLAUDE.md files, MCP tools, skills and memory are sent with every request. Run /context to see what takes up space, then trim or turn off what you don't need."
translations.chinese: "CLAUDE.md 文件、MCP 工具、技能和记忆会随每个请求发送。运行 /context 查看占用空间的内容，然后精简或关闭不需要的部分。"

translations.original: "This report includes your feedback, environment info, and the current session transcript. We may use these to debug related issues and improve Claude Code."
translations.chinese: "此报告包含你的反馈、环境信息和当前会话记录。我们可能会用这些信息来排查相关问题并改进 Claude Code。"

translations.original: "Saved, but this session still shows the previous value. A higher-priority setting may be overriding it, or the session hasn't picked the change up yet."
translations.chinese: "已保存，但本次会话仍显示之前的值。更高优先级的设置可能覆盖了它，或者会话尚未应用该更改。"

translations.original: "It may be turned off in another settings file, or your organization's settings may not allow the command that updates it. Copy the error to see which."
translations.chinese: "它可能在另一个设置文件中被关闭，或者你的组织设置不允许更新它所需的命令。请复制错误以查看是哪一个。"

translations.original: "Rules and workspace directories come from the running session, including approvals made for this session only and rules set when the session started."
translations.chinese: "规则和工作区目录来自正在运行的会话，包括仅本次会话做出的批准，以及会话启动时设置的规则。"

translations.original: It's now off for your team in .claude/settings.json, but other settings still turn it on for you, most likely your own .claude/settings.local.json.
translations.chinese: 它现在已在团队的 .claude/settings.json 中关闭，但其他设置仍为你开启它，很可能是你自己的 .claude/settings.local.json。

translations.original: "Only hooks from managed settings can run. Hooks from user, project, local, and flag settings are blocked, and managed hooks are not shown here."
translations.chinese: "只有来自托管设置的钩子可以运行。来自用户、项目、本地和启动设置（flag）的钩子会被阻止，且此处不显示托管钩子。"

translations.original: "It's turned on in .claude/settings.json, which your team shares, so uninstalling it removes it for everyone on your team who uses this project."
translations.chinese: "它已在团队共享的 .claude/settings.json 中开启，因此卸载它会对团队中所有使用此项目的人生效。"

translations.original: "Check that it's a GitHub owner/repo, a git URL, a URL or path to a marketplace.json file, or a folder that exists. Copy the error to see why."
translations.chinese: "请确认它是 GitHub owner/repo、git URL、指向 marketplace.json 文件的 URL 或路径，或一个存在的文件夹。请复制错误以查看原因。"

translations.original: "Claude knows which file you're viewing in VS Code, and can see what's selected. Highlight code in the editor, then prompt Claude to edit it."
translations.chinese: "Claude 知道你在 VS Code 中查看哪个文件，也能看到选中的内容。在编辑器中选中代码，然后让 Claude 修改它。"

translations.original: "If this notice is still here after a minute, close this tab and reopen the conversation from the session list in the Claude Code sidebar."
translations.chinese: "如果一分钟后此提示仍然存在，请关闭此标签页，并从 Claude Code 侧边栏的会话列表重新打开对话。"

translations.original: "Each subagent runs its own requests. Be deliberate about spawning them — and consider configuring a cheaper model for simpler subagents."
translations.chinese: "每个子代理都会运行自己的请求。请谨慎创建子代理——并考虑为较简单的子代理配置更便宜的模型。"

translations.original: , and this session still shows the previous value. The switch shows what this session has now; try again, or reopen this dialog to check.
translations.chinese: ，且本次会话仍显示之前的值。开关显示的是本次会话当前的值；请重试，或重新打开此对话框检查。

translations.original: "Enterprise managed settings allow only managed permission rules. Rules from other settings files are shown below but are not in effect."
translations.chinese: "企业托管设置仅允许托管权限规则。来自其他设置文件的规则显示在下方，但不会生效。"

translations.original: It's turned on in .claude/settings.json, which your team shares, so turning it off there turns it off for everyone who uses this project.
translations.chinese: 它已在你的团队共享的 .claude/settings.json 中开启，因此在那里关闭它会对所有使用此项目的人生效。

translations.original: "When a command fails because of a sandbox restriction, Claude may retry it outside the sandbox, with the usual permission prompts."
translations.chinese: "当命令因沙盒限制失败时，Claude 可以在沙盒外重试，并使用常规权限提示。"

translations.original: "Max effort thinks much longer on every step. Save it for the hardest tasks and use a lower level for everyday work (model picker)."
translations.chinese: "最大努力级别会在每一步思考更久。请将其留给最难的任务，日常工作使用较低级别（模型选择器）。"

translations.original: "This plugin, or a plugin it needs, would use the same folder as another plugin. Copy the error to see which one and what to do."
translations.chinese: "此插件或它需要的插件会与另一个插件使用同一文件夹。请复制错误以查看是哪一个以及如何处理。"

translations.original: "No browsers are connected. Open Chrome with the Claude extension and make sure you're signed in to the same claude.ai account."
translations.chinese: "没有已连接的浏览器。请打开安装了 Claude 扩展的 Chrome，并确认你已登录同一个 claude.ai 账户。"

translations.original: "Saved, but this session still shows the previous value. It may not have picked the change up yet; reopen this dialog to check."
translations.chinese: "已保存，但本次会话仍显示之前的值。它可能尚未应用该更改；请重新打开此对话框检查。"

translations.original: "Saved, but this session still shows the previous state. It may not have picked the change up yet; reopen this dialog to check."
translations.chinese: "已保存，但本次会话仍显示之前的状态。它可能尚未应用该更改；请重新打开此对话框检查。"

translations.original: "This response can't be shown because your plugins check each response in the conversation, and this one is no longer there."
translations.chinese: "无法显示此回复，因为你的插件会检查对话中的每条回复，而此回复已不在对话中。"

translations.original: "; session hooks created by /goal, agents, and skills still run. Settings edits save but don't load until safe mode is off."
translations.chinese: "；由 /goal、Agent 和技能创建的会话钩子仍会运行。设置修改会保存，但在关闭安全模式前不会加载。"

translations.original: "Turn it on to update it. Your organization's settings can also block the command it needs, and then it still won't update."
translations.chinese: "开启它才能更新。你的组织设置也可能阻止它需要的命令，那样仍然无法更新。"

translations.original: "Hooks run your commands, prompts, or HTTP calls in response to Claude Code events like tool calls and prompt submission."
translations.chinese: "钩子会在工具调用、提交提示词等 Claude Code 事件发生时运行你的命令、提示词或 HTTP 调用。"

translations.original: "The rule is deleted from its settings file and stops applying to this session once Claude Code has re-read its settings."
translations.chinese: "该规则会从其设置文件中删除，并在 Claude Code 重新读取设置后不再应用于本次会话。"

translations.original: "MCP tool results stay in context for the rest of the session. /compact to flush them, or disable servers you don't need."
translations.chinese: "MCP 工具结果会在会话剩余时间内保留在上下文中。使用 /compact 清除它们，或禁用不需要的服务器。"

translations.original: "The packages it lists weren't installed. If it needs them, parts of it may not work. Updating the plugin tries again."
translations.chinese: "它列出的包未安装。如果它需要这些包，部分功能可能无法使用。更新插件会再次尝试。"

translations.original: "A record says it was accepted before, but that record is kept where it can't be relied on, so you're asked again."
translations.chinese: "记录显示此前已接受过，但该记录保存在不可靠的位置，因此会再次询问你。"

translations.original: "Keeps the default coding instructions alongside your style. Turn off for styles that are not about writing code."
translations.chinese: "在保留你的样式的同时保留默认编码指令。对于与编写代码无关的样式，请关闭此项。"

translations.original: "May use excessive tokens resulting in long response times or overthinking. Use sparingly for the hardest tasks."
translations.chinese: "可能会消耗过多 token，导致响应时间过长或过度思考。仅在处理最难的任务时少量使用。"

translations.original: "Complete the sign-in in the browser window that opened. You have five minutes; closing this dialog cancels it."
translations.chinese: "请在打开的浏览器窗口中完成登录。你有五分钟时间；关闭此对话框将取消操作。"

translations.original: "These are often background/loop sessions. Continuous usage can add up quickly so make sure it is intentional."
translations.chinese: "这些通常是后台/循环会话。持续使用会快速累积，请确保是有意为之。"

translations.original: "If this runs frequently, consider configuring its subagents with a cheaper model or tightening their prompts."
translations.chinese: "如果此功能经常运行，请考虑为其子代理配置更便宜的模型，或收紧它们的提示词。"

translations.original: "It's turned on in .claude/settings.json, which your team shares, so uninstalling your copy would leave it on."
translations.chinese: "它已在团队共享的 .claude/settings.json 中开启，因此卸载你的副本后它仍会保持开启。"

translations.original: "Longer sessions are more expensive even when cached. /compact mid-task, /clear when switching to new tasks."
translations.chinese: "即使有缓存，更长的会话也更昂贵。任务中途使用 /compact，切换到新任务时使用 /clear。"

translations.original: "Could not move this to the background. It may have just finished or already be running in the background."
translations.chinese: "无法将其移到后台。它可能刚刚完成，或已经在后台运行。"

translations.original: "This hook contains hidden characters. They are invisible in these fields; the list shows them as codes."
translations.chinese: "此钩子包含隐藏字符。它们在这些字段中不可见；列表会将它们显示为代码。"

translations.original: "This conversation is still open somewhere else. Using it in two places at once can mix up its messages."
translations.chinese: "此对话仍在其他地方打开。同时在两处使用可能会混淆它的消息。"

translations.original: . If the rule is still shown, Claude Code is still re-reading its settings; reopen this dialog to check.
translations.chinese: 。如果规则仍然显示，说明 Claude Code 仍在重新读取设置；请重新打开此对话框检查。

translations.original: "The sandbox is on in the settings but did not start in this session; start a new session to try again."
translations.chinese: "设置中已开启沙盒，但本次会话未能启动；请新建会话重试。"

translations.original: , is added, but its location is on a network drive, has "." or ".." in its path, or couldn't be checked.
translations.chinese: ，已添加，但其位置位于网络驱动器、路径中包含“.”或“..”，或无法检查。

translations.original: "The packages it lists couldn't be installed automatically. If it needs them, parts of it may not work."
translations.chinese: "它列出的包无法自动安装。如果它需要这些包，部分功能可能无法使用。"

translations.original: "If this notice is still here after a minute, close this tab and sign in from the Claude Code sidebar."
translations.chinese: "如果一分钟后此提示仍然存在，请关闭此标签页，并从 Claude Code 侧边栏登录。"

translations.original: "Click a hook to view, edit, or remove it. Managed, plugin, session, and built-in hooks are read-only."
translations.chinese: "点击钩子可查看、编辑或移除它。托管、插件、会话和内置钩子为只读。"

translations.original: "Another installation or your team's settings turn it on, and turning it off just for you didn't work."
translations.chinese: "另一个安装或你的团队设置将它开启，而仅为你关闭它并未成功。"

translations.original: ", or it ignores this rule (in auto permission mode, allow rules for risky commands are not applied)."
translations.chinese: "，或者它忽略了此规则（在自动权限模式下，针对高风险命令的允许规则不会生效）。"

translations.original: "Review what this plugin contributes — its agents, skills, and MCP tools all count toward your limit."
translations.chinese: "检查此插件贡献的内容——它的 Agent、技能和 MCP 工具都会计入你的限额。"

translations.original: "Approximate, based on local sessions on this machine — does not include other devices or claude.ai"
translations.chinese: "近似值，基于此机器上的本地会话——不包含其他设备或 claude.ai"

translations.original: "Its copy from claude.ai isn't loaded; a plugin on this machine with the same name takes its place."
translations.chinese: "来自 claude.ai 的副本未加载；此机器上同名的插件会取代它。"

translations.original: "The names differ only in letter case or in characters folder names ignore, so both can't be added."
translations.chinese: "这些名称仅在字母大小写或文件夹名称忽略的字符上不同，因此无法同时添加两者。"

translations.original: "This session runs on another machine, so its permission rules can be viewed here but not changed."
translations.chinese: "本次会话在另一台机器上运行，因此可以在此查看其权限规则，但无法更改。"

translations.original: "Claude Code stopped responding in this tab, usually because the editor restarted its extensions."
translations.chinese: "Claude Code 在此标签页中停止响应，通常是因为编辑器重启了扩展。"

translations.original: "It is turned off in your user settings, but another settings file turns it on, so it still runs."
translations.chinese: "它已在你的用户设置中关闭，但另一个设置文件将其开启，因此它仍在运行。"

translations.original: "All sessions share one limit. If you don't need them all at once, queueing uses it more evenly."
translations.chinese: "所有会话共享一个限额。如果你不需要同时使用全部会话，排队会更均匀地消耗限额。"

translations.original: "Settings can't store an entry with this name; rename the skill's folder or file to configure it"
translations.chinese: "设置无法存储此名称的条目；请重命名技能的文件夹或文件以进行配置"

translations.original: "When explaining code, architecture, or data flow, start with a diagram, then explain in prose."
translations.chinese: "在解释代码、架构或数据流时，先画图表，再用文字说明。"

translations.original: "Its hooks aren't running, because your organization only allows hooks from plugins it manages."
translations.chinese: "其钩子未运行，因为你的组织仅允许其管理的插件提供的钩子。"

translations.original: "A plugin it needs is missing, or the versions don't fit together. Copy the error to see which."
translations.chinese: "缺少它需要的插件，或版本不兼容。请复制错误以查看是哪一个。"

translations.original: "Show Claude Code status including version, model, account, API connectivity, and tool statuses"
translations.chinese: "显示 Claude Code 状态，包括版本、模型、账户、API 连接和工具状态"

translations.original: "If the redirect page shows a connection error, paste the URL from your browser's address bar:"
translations.chinese: "如果重定向页面显示连接错误，请粘贴浏览器地址栏中的 URL："

translations.original: It's off in your .claude/settings.local.json, but settings this dialog can't change keep it on.
translations.chinese: 它已在你的 .claude/settings.local.json 中关闭，但此对话框无法更改的设置仍保持开启。

translations.chinese: "Claude Code 因它需要的命令或下载而停止了操作。请复制错误以查看原因。"

translations.original: "It makes the access details, such as a token, sent with the download from the address below."
translations.chinese: "它会让访问凭据（例如 token）随下载一起发送到下面的地址。"

translations.chinese: ，且本次会话仍显示之前的值。请重试，或重新打开此对话框检查。

translations.original: . Not listed yet: this session is still re-reading its settings (reopen this dialog to check)
translations.chinese: 。尚未列出：本次会话仍在重新读取其设置（重新打开此对话框检查）

translations.original: , and this session still shows the previous state. Try again, or reopen this dialog to check.
translations.chinese: ，且本次会话仍显示之前的状态。请重试，或重新打开此对话框检查。

translations.original: "This was shown before your plugins checked it. Text they would hide may have been visible."
translations.chinese: "此内容在你的插件检查之前就已显示。插件本应隐藏的文本可能曾经可见。"

translations.original: "A permission rule is a tool name, optionally followed by a specifier in parentheses, e.g. "
translations.chinese: "权限规则是工具名称，后面可选括号中的说明符，例如 "

translations.original: "Headers (Header-Name: value, one per line; stored values are kept unless you retype them)"
